title: Biohydrogen purification by CO2 capture with deep eutectic solvents
content:
Abstract

The presence of CO2 in biohydrogen limits its industrial applications, particularly in fuel cells. In order to enhance biohydrogen purity and realize its application, a novel biohydrogen purification device with a CO2 capture chamber and a deep eutectic solvents (DESs) regeneration chamber was used to capture CO2 in biohydrogen by employing DESs. The key operational parameters such as device stirring rate, reaction temperature, and biohydrogen flow rate were investigated. Optimal conditions were identified as a biohydrogen flow rate of 2 L/min, a reaction temperature of 40°C, and a stirring rate of 500 r/min. Under these conditions, CO2 capture capacity of 411 g (0.343 g CO2/g DESs) was achieved, with purified hydrogen concentrations (≥99.00%) sustained for 183 min. Furthermore, the DESs still demonstrated excellent regeneration and CO2 capture performance after 4 heating cycles. This research provided a viable solution for efficient CO2 capture in biohydrogen, facilitating its industrial application.
